scope: Review one bounded execution transaction for an exact prepared .scscript in a clean design.

checks.name: single_purpose
checks.notes: The operation executes once and records outcome; it does not interpret geometry or alter the build plan.

checks.name: entry_gate
checks.notes: Document state, blocking dialogs, artifact identity, output ownership, and authorization are explicit preconditions.

checks.name: failure_boundary
checks.notes: Uncertain completion and partial geometry require a safe stop and clean rerun.

checks.name: evidence_boundary
checks.notes: No SpaceClaim runtime result is claimed until the exact artifact is observed running.

notes: This candidate is operation-agnostic and remains untested as a reusable controller transaction. Composition-case runtime evidence is intentionally not inherited.
